body.note: Status:G-A Number: 2674 Name of book transcribed: GalatiansFirst folio transcribed: f108rBase text: TR1873ns (12Apr2012)Transcribed by: agpTranscription begun: 12 Oct 16Transcription finished: 18 Nov 16 Does this manuscript contain (delete and complete as appropriate): Lectionary annotations - No Initials and other enlarged letters - Yes Diples (> or >> in the margin next to certain text, indicating that text is a quotation from the Old Testament) - No Are there any special symbols in the margin next to any of the following verses: (to be specified): Other remarks: There seems to be no proper inscriptio but only a notice indicating the beginning of chapter one, which I transcribe here: επιστολη προς γαλατας κεφαλαιον α´

ab.note: -note- The manuscript adds after the inscription κεφαλαιον α´.
